names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 februarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Gavriil».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Γαβριήλ ο Οσιομάρτυρας ο εν Κωνσταντινουπόλει», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Gavriil»

attestations.note: The day is the Meeting of the Lord. His own page on the site carries the name, the date, an icon and the readings appointed for a martyr, and no life and no troparion.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Γαβριήλ ο Οσιομάρτυρας ο εν Κωνσταντινουπόλει»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.02.2026 (2. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Исто тако пострада и монах Гаврил, канонарх Велике цркве у Цариграду 1672. године.“

attestations.note: Read from the Prologue text on the page, not from its entry list, which does not print him at all. He has no entry of his own there: the Prologue names him in the closing sentence of its second entry, that of the new martyr Jordan. It disagrees with saint.gr twice over, and the disagreement is recorded rather than resolved — 1672 against saint.gr's 1676, and канонарх Велике цркве, canonarch of the Great Church, against saint.gr's preacher of the Patriarchate's parish.

death.note: Two sources, two years, and the interval is the disagreement. saint.gr: «αποκεφαλίστηκε στις 2 Φεβρουαρίου 1676 μ.Χ.», with the page's own head «Αγιος Γαβριηλ ο Οσιομαρτυρας ο Εν Κωνσταντινουπολει (; - 1676)»; the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 2 February: „Исто тако пострада и монах Гаврил, канонарх Велике цркве у Цариграду 1672. године.“
